tagline: To fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality
hero_kpi_rationale: Net room openings are the primary indicator of organic growth in hospitality, reflecting the strength of the asset-light model and global pipeline expansion.

kpis.name: Net Room Additions
kpis.explanation: Number of rooms added to the network after deducting departures.
kpis.description: Net additions reflect true network growth after departures. In 2025, net growth reached 6.7%.
kpis.signal: Solid organic growth with 81.1K net rooms in 2025.

kpis.name: Development Pipeline (rooms)
kpis.explanation: Total number of rooms in hotels scheduled to open in the future.
kpis.description: The pipeline represents hotels under development. In 2025, it reaches 3,703 hotels for 520,500 rooms.
kpis.signal: Massive pipeline of 520.5K rooms, evidence of sustainable future growth.

kpis.name: Hilton Honors Members
kpis.description: The Hilton Honors program is central to customer retention. It counted 243M members at end of 2025.
kpis.signal: 243 million members, +15% year-over-year: key driver of recurrence and loyalty.

kpis.name: System-wide Rooms
kpis.explanation: Total number of rooms across all hotels in the network.
kpis.description: At end of 2025, Hilton operates 1.35M rooms across 143 countries.
kpis.signal: 1.35 million rooms across 9,158 hotels, confirmed global leadership.

kpis.name: System-wide Hotels
kpis.explanation: Total number of hotels in the global network.
kpis.description: The global network comprises 9,158 hotels at end of 2025.
kpis.signal: 9,158 operating hotels, solid foundation for future growth.

kpis.name: Net Unit Growth
kpis.explanation: Annual growth rate of room count after departures.
kpis.signal: Organic growth of 6.7%, among the highest in the hospitality sector.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 16.77B$ in the latest year.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 13.09B$ in the latest year.

kpis.name: Dividends Per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the past 7 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Dividends per share of 0.15$ in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the past 4 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 0.143B$ in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio: Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the past 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 9.8% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the past 8 reported fiscal years 10-K.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of 12.039B$ in the latest year.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Consolidated annual net income, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the past 8 reported fiscal years 10-K.
kpis.signal: Net income of 1.457B$ in the latest year.

kpis.name: Hilton Honors Members
kpis.description: The Hilton Honors program is central to customer retention. It counted 243M members at end of 2025.
kpis.signal: 243 million members, +15% year-over-year: key driver of recurrence and loyalty.

risks.title: Cyberattacks
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly mentions cyberattacks as a major risk, with high-intensity language and context of increasing threat sophistication, including AI-powered threats.

risks.title: Information Technology Systems Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on its information technology and technology systems, exposing it to outages and service disruptions.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations in the countries where it operates, which may impact its business and results.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market with established players and new entrants, which may impact its market share and results.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company operates across many countries and territories (143), making it vulnerable to geopolitical risks, such as conflicts, sanctions, and regime changes.

risks.title: Dependence on Partners and Owners
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on its partners and owners to deliver services, making it vulnerable to partner failures or service interruptions.

risks.title: Reputation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to reputation risks, including non-compliance with regulations, security issues, or quality of service problems.

ai_positioning.summary: Hilton acknowledges growing AI-related threats in the context of cyberattacks, but does not integrate AI as a strategic element of its operational model or product offering.
evidence: 10-K Item 1A Risk Factors: explicit mention of sophisticated cyberattacks leveraging AI.
